name: uCompute (RP2040, v1.2/v1.3)
notes: JP Michon's original uCompute, with the RP2040 soldered on the board. Runs the generic Pico firmware, so it reports itself as the Pico: pick it by hand in the Board menu. 240x240 ST7789 on SPI bus 0 (GP2/GP3), no CS pin, backlight on GP6. The maker's code drives it in SPI mode 3 (polarity 1, phase 1). v1.3 can take an SSD1306 OLED (0x3C) instead; it shares I2C bus 0 (GP20/GP21) with a CAT24 EEPROM (0x50). The three buttons share GP26 through a resistor ladder: idle reads above 40000, right below 7000, select below 12000, left below 16000 (read_u16). Buzzer on GP11 (PWM), NeoPixel port on GP23 (8 LEDs by default). MicroSD and the rear expansion port share SPI bus 1 (GP14/GP15/GP12), SD CS GP13, card detect GP7, module CS GP8, INT GP9, RST GP10. H1 header carries GP0/GP1 (UART0), GP16-19, GP22, GP24 (v1.3), GP27 and GP28. Pins are from the maker's README (github.com/JPMichon/RP2040_uCompute); check your own unit.
